title: Baltic Sea anomaly expedition
summary: Jesse Michels tells of Baltic Sea anomaly expedition, about present at Baltic Sea anomaly, between Sweden and Finland, and says they saw it or took part. As told, not a fact.
place_text: Baltic Sea between Sweden and Finland

as_told.title: Host's own expedition to the anomaly
as_told.place_text: Baltic Sea, 60 km out between Finland and Sweden

plain: A podcast host, Jesse Michels, says he took part in an expedition to a strange object on the floor of the Baltic Sea, roughly halfway between Sweden and Finland. According to Michels, a man named Dennis Asper found the thing there, and its shape looks like the Millennium Falcon, the spaceship from the Star Wars films. If it were what its shape suggests, it would be something built, not natural, sitting at the bottom of the sea.
